Omni-bot 0.93 compatibility source import

Origin (read-only): C:/Users/micha/Documents/GitHub/etlegacy/vendor/omni-bot/source/Omnibot
Imported 2026-10-08 for the ETmain-compatible game bridge. No upstream rewrite
sources were imported. Files retain original notices; imported code is unchanged.

Included: Common, ET, active GameMonkey Ex/WildMagic3/iprof/PhysicsFS dependencies,
the source CMake files, and MSVC Common.rc/resource.h. RTCW, Recast, unused GUI
frontends, dependency extras/tests/docs and old project files were not imported.
Root build must disable OMNIBOT_RTCW. Common/BotLoadLibrary.cpp and the bridge ABI
headers also live in ../omnibot (relative to this vendor directory) as copies
from the SAME compatible source tree, not the newer ETLegacy loader interface.

Build this as a separate CMake source directory:
  cmake -S src/vendor/omni-bot/source/Omnibot -B build/omnibot -DOMNIBOT_ET=ON -DOMNIBOT_RTCW=OFF -DOMNIBOT_STD_FILESYSTEM=ON
No build was run during import. Its CMake uses CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR/dependencies;
ExternalProject or a separate configure is required, not add_subdirectory.
Boost headers remain an external development dependency. Set
OMNIBOT_BOOST_INCLUDEDIR to the directory containing boost/version.hpp or let
find_package(Boost) locate them. STD_FILESYSTEM=ON avoids compiled Boost libraries
and requires C++17. Platform compiler/SDK dependencies remain external.
For 32-bit builds select the matching compiler architecture/toolchain; the bot
must match the loading qagame process. Names: omnibot_et.dll (Win32), omnibot_et.so
(Linux i386), omnibot_et_x64.dll (Win64), omnibot_et.x86_64.so (Linux64).
The exported ABI entry is ExportBotFunctionsFromDLL; library base is omnibot_et.

LICENSING PROVENANCE / OPEN MATERIAL
- PhysicsFS LICENSE.txt is included unchanged (zlib-style notice).
- GameMonkey permission/license is included in gmMachine.h; preserve that header.
- zlib/LZMA and other dependency notices remain in their source headers/README.
- WildMagic3 headers point to an external WildMagic3License.pdf; no standalone
  copy was present in the supplied compatible source tree or source archive.
- No top-level Omni-bot license text was found in the supplied compatible source
  tree or omni-bot-0.93.zip. iprof also has no separate license file in this tree.
No substitute license from the incompatible upstream rewrite was applied. These
missing texts are explicitly unresolved provenance, not a grant inferred from
ETLegacy's repository license. Review before redistribution.

Runtime scripts/navigation are local staging only in tce2/omni-bot. They are not
part of this source import. No runtime DLL/SO, archives or generated artifacts
were copied. Existing ET scripts/nav do not establish TC map navigation, weapon
mapping, GT2/5/7 objective behavior or successful bot operation.
